mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( id, checkout_id, customer_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, shop_id, shop_name, status, subtotal, shipping_fee, total_amount, shipping_method, payment_method, payment_status, delivery_slot_start, delivery_slot_end, note ) VALUES ( #{o.id}, #{o.checkoutId}, #{o.customerId}, #{o.receiverName}, #{o.receiverPhone}, #{o.receiverAddress}, #{o.shopId}, #{o.shopName}, #{o.status}, #{o.subtotal}, #{o.shippingFee}, #{o.totalAmount}, #{o.shippingMethod}, #{o.paymentMethod}, #{o.paymentStatus}, #{o.deliverySlotStart}, #{o.deliverySlotEnd}, #{o.note} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, checkout_id, customer_id, receiver_name, receiver_address, receiver_phone, shop_id, shop_name, status, subtotal, shipping_fee, total_amount, shipping_method, payment_method, payment_status, delivery_slot_start, delivery_slot_end, note, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.id, o.checkout_id, o.shop_id, o.shop_name, o.status, o.subtotal, o.shipping_fee, o.total_amount, o.payment_method, o.payment_status, o.created_at, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0)::int AS total_items FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
